summary: Track 18.00 Phase F (Portal-Aware Data Layer + Dispatch Surface Polish) end-to-end verification PASSED. Backend pytest suite (40/40) + live API + multi-portal browser flows all green. TopBar mounted on every dispatch surface, dashboard endpoint portal-aware, detail endpoints remain admin-strict, Admin TopBar group correctly admin-only, mobile hamburger toggle works, TxOpsRestricted component compliant, Phase D right rail intact, admin oversight preserved, no Admin Console wording anywhere for dispatch users, zero page errors on the 5 key surfaces.
critical_code_review_comments: Spec wording in the review request used testid prefix 'txops-portal-topbar-group-admin' but actual runtime DOM uses 'txops-topbar-group-admin' (no '-portal-' segment). The functional behavior is correct (admin group hidden for dispatch session, visible for admin) — only the documentation/spec text is mismatched. Phase F pytest test_15_topbar_admin_group_is_admin_only at static source level passes, so this is purely a doc discrepancy.

/admin/transportation shell renders the Transportation TopBar in expanded layout (section labels + inline links: 'OPERATIONS', 'PEOPLE', 'COMPLIANCE', 'OPERATIONS INTELLIGENCE', 'ADMINISTRATION · Reports, Administration') rather than the compact dropdown-button layout used at /dispatch-portal. The admin Administration section IS visible there — just not via the same testid pattern. This is by design (different mount context) but worth documenting for testing agents.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase F is complete and stable. Key DOM contracts to remember: (1) Transportation TopBar root testid = 'txops-portal-topbar'. (2) Group buttons (compact/dispatch mount) = 'txops-topbar-group-{ops|people|compliance|intel|admin}' — note NO '-portal-' segment between 'txops' and 'topbar'. (3) Mobile hamburger = 'txops-portal-topbar-mobile-toggle' (hidden >=md, visible <md). (4) Mobile nav container = 'txops-portal-topbar-mobile-nav'. (5) Mobile nav items prefix = 'txops-topbar-mobile-item-*'. (6) Phase D right rail container = 'txops-right-rail' with 5 sections: 'txops-rail-recent-activity', 'txops-rail-timeline', 'txops-rail-related', 'txops-rail-open-actions', 'txops-rail-audit'. (7) Mission Control link in dispatch portal = 'txops-portal-topbar-mission-control' → href '/transportation-operations'. (8) /transportation-operations shell testid = 'admin-transportation-page'. (9) Admin sidenav testid on /admin/transportation = 'admin-side-nav-v2' (combined with class 'admin-side-nav'). (10) Multi-login response: tokens live under d.portal_tokens.admin and d.portal_tokens.dispatch; session_token is separate. localStorage keys: masci.admin.token, masci.dispatch.token, masci_jwt_v1, masci.directory.user. (11) /dispatch-portal/fleet is intentionally deferred (Phase G). (12) Background 401 noise on dispatch-context admin endpoints is expected and acceptable.
